_why: Tail family for ISCO minor group 742 (Electronics and Telecom Installation). Bound at MINOR level (specificity 30) rather than per unit group: the 742x units are narrow industrial specialisations whose workers would get near-identical questions, and 158 near-duplicate packs would be padding that LOOKS like coverage. A unit-level family always wins over this one — that is what the six specificity levels are for.
